answer: The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, clawed back after a replayed submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the knoll of a task receipt, and the forge is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
